title: dactylorhiza incarnata var. brachyphylla
intro: Dactylorhiza incarnata var. brachyphylla, commonly known as the Red Helleborine, is a type of orchid found in various regions of the world. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide several health benefits, including its potential to lower blood sugar levels and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza incarnata var. brachyphylla include its ability to act as a vasodilator, which can help to improve blood circulation, as well as its possible role in reducing stress and anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
